statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: Recent run-rate sits right at the threshold: 2025 annual growth 2.3% (revised), 2024 3.2%; 2026 quarterly annualised rates 1.4% (Q1), 2.1% (Q2), 3.6% (Q3 prelim); year-over-year 2.1% in Q3 2026. No AI-driven productivity break visible yet in the series; outcome for 2027 is close to a coin flip on current data. Statement refers to the Bloc A statistics series.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office, preliminary Q4 2025 release: nonfarm business labour productivity rose 2.2% in 2025 (annual average); Q4 2025 +2.8% annualised.
items.detail: BLS 'Productivity and Costs, Fourth Quarter and Annual Averages 2025, Preliminary', released Thursday 2026-03-05; first-print values read from the Wayback capture of that day.

items.summary: Q1 2026 nonfarm business productivity growth was weak: ~0.8% annualised in the first print, ~2.9% year over year.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs Q1 2026, preliminary (2026-05-07); first-print values per the archived release prod2_05072026.

items.summary: Q2 2026 preliminary: nonfarm business productivity +1.4% annualised (+2.2% over four quarters); unit labour costs +1.3% annualised, +1.4% over four quarters.
items.detail: BLS 'Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2026, Preliminary' (2026-08-06). Later revised to +2.1% (2026-11-05 release).

items.summary: Q3 2026 preliminary: nonfarm business productivity +3.6% annualised (output +3.7%, hours +0.1%), +2.1% year over year; Q2 revised to +2.1%. Typical revision band for the first print is -1.1 to +1.4 pp.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs Q3 2026 preliminary, Table 2 (2026-11-05); index 121.9 (2017=100).
